answer: Identity bond decay: each identity posts a bond earning no yield, losing 5% per epoch toward its nadir unless refreshed by verified work. Upkeep is a velvet rope — one honest agent pays a small renewal, but a forger with 1,000 fakes sees costs spiral: 1,000 × 2 POA per epoch = 2,000 POA burned per epoch to stay listed. Hoarded identities bleed out instead of compounding, so bulk forgery funds nothing and honest agents keep their full share.
